SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY 
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    pc.issued_on,
    pc.expires_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op_sh ON op.registered_region = op_sh.registered_region
JOIN organization_unit ou ON op_sh.registered_region = ou.region_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) * 1.0, 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM 
    delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id =! ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) * 1.0, 2) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution inst ON eg.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(dse.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN 
    institution i ON dse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
    AND r.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
    AND ds.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM delinquency_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(ps.recognized_amount, 0)), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(ps.recognized_amount, 0)) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    op.display_name AS payee_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party op ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile opf ON op.party_id = opf.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON opf.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE !s0 END), 2) AS non_compliant_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pe.amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_commitment_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS credit_agreement_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_commitment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    op_ind.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_ind.sector_name_zh AS agreement_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector op_ind ON op.industry_code = op_ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    industry_sector ca_ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    payer_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    payee_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON from_acc.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_to ON to_acc.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party payer_party ON ah_from.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    party payee_party ON ah_to.party_id = payee_party.party_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON (
        (pr.source_party_id = payer_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee_party.party_id)
        OR 
        (pr.source_party_id = payee_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer_party.party_id)
    )
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isc ON op.industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE 
    isc.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    ROUND(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(cdd.deadline_date), 2) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.completion_date IS NULL
    AND cdd.deadline_date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    so.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM loan_balances
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_industry_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        op.industry_code,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lib.industry_code,
        lib.loan_id,
        lib.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lib.industry_code 
            ORDER BY lib.principal_balance DESC
        ) as industry_rank
    FROM loan_industry_balance lib
)
SELECT 
    isc.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    ROUND(rl.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rl.industry_rank
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector isc ON rl.industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE rl.industry_rank <= 3
ORDER BY isc.sector_name_zh ASC, rl.industry_rank ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
) t
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH inst_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    ia.institution_name,
    lbs.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN inst_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue!_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 360
    END AS overdue_interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 360
    END
ORDER BY overdue_interval_start ASC;

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_tx_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_tx_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pe.amount), 6) AS related_ratio
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN 
    account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id 
                     AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id 
                     AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to > pe.business_date)
                     AND pr.effective_from <= pe.business_date
JOIN 
    institution i ON COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    related_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,

FROM

    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON ah.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'

    AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT

FROM

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,

    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs 
        ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
            FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
            WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
        )
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        SUM(l.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot l
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
    WHERE l.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
),
total_sum AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_balance) AS grand_total FROM industry_balances
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.industry_name,
        ib.total_balance,
        SUM(ib.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY ib.total_balance DESC) AS running_total,
        ts.grand_total
    FROM industry_balances ib
    CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
),
cumulative_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        ROUND(running_total * 1.0 / grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM ranked_industries
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative_calc
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

GROUP BY

HAVING

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,

    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM

    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id

    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id

        FROM collateral_valuation cv_inner
        WHERE cv_inner.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT

JOIN

    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

WITH inst_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    ia.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - (ia.avg_principal_balance * 2), 2) AS excess_diff
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN inst_avg ia ON i.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > (ia.avg_principal_balance * 2)
ORDER BY excess_diff DESC;

WITH all_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ca.contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
   !JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
),
non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name AS institution_name,
        ca.contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
          AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
),
agg_all AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        institution_name,
        SUM(contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM all_agreements
    GROUP BY institution_id, institution_name
),
agg_non_related AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM non_related_agreements
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    a.institution_name AS "机构名称",
    COALESCE(n.non_related_amount, 0) AS "非关联金额",
    a.total_amount AS "全部金额",
    ROUND(COALESCE(n.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / a.total_amount, 6) AS "占比"
FROM agg_all a
LEFT JOIN agg_non_related n ON a.institution_id = n.institution_id
ORDER BY "占比" DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS execution_rate,
    ROUND(industry_avg.avg_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - industry_avg.avg_rate) * 100.0 / industry_avg.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            op2.industry_code,
            AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
        FROM 
            credit_agreement ca2
        JOIN 
            organization_profile op2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = op2.party_id
        WHERE 
            ca2.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
            AND op2.industry_code IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 
            op2.industry_code
    ) industry_avg ON op.industry_code = industry_avg.industry_code
WHERE 
    ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.annual_interest_rate > industry_avg.avg_rate * 1.10
ORDER BY 
    markup_percent DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS excess_customer_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    excess_customer_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = eg.institution_id)
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status AS loan_status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY 
    days_between ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.institution_id,
        c.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement c ON ld.agreement_id = c.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY c.institution_id,! c.borrower_party_id
),
capital_net AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.borrower_party_id,
        lb.total_principal_balance,
        cn.net_capital,
        ROUND(lb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / cn.net_capital, 6) AS ratio_val
    FROM loan_balances lb
    JOIN capital_net cn ON lb.institution_id = cn.institution_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        r.borrower_party_id,
        r.ratio_val,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.institution_id ORDER BY r.ratio_val DESC) AS rn
    FROM ratios r
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ranked.ratio_val
FROM ranked
JOIN institution i ON ranked.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ranked.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC
        ) AS quartile_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_rank
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE quartile_rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quartile_rank ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    percentage DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING 
    COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT

FROM 
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY

HAVING

ORDER BY

LIMIT 200;

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id

SELECT a.account_id

    FROM payment_event p

LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    gc.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_maturity AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.current_maturity_on,
        CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_remaining
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
),
categorized_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN days_remaining < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN days_remaining >= 0 AND days_remaining <= 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS maturity_bucket
    FROM loan_maturity
)
SELECT 
    maturity_bucket AS "档位",
    COUNT(*) AS "笔数"
FROM categorized_loans
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY 
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS association_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    association_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 
    avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH RepaymentAccountStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS!

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
    AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    pc.card_type,
    pc.issued_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
    AND pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_self_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY 
    entrusted_ratio ASC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    total_agg.total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / total_agg.total_disbursed_amount * 100, 2) AS single_disbursement_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            agreement_id, 
            SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown
        GROUP BY 
            agreement_id
    ) total_agg ON ld.agreement_id = total_agg.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / total_agg.total_disbursed!_amount * 100, 2) > 90
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status != 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS actual_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status != 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS completion_ratio
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_ratio > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_overdue.has_overdue_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ld_inner.loan_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_overdue_flag
    FROM 
        loan_drawdown ld_inner
    LEFT JOIN 
        repayment_schedule rs ON ld_inner.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE 
        ld_inner.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SETTLED')
    GROUP BY 
        ld_inner.loan_id
) has_overdue ON ld.loan_id = has_overdue.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ld.status IN ('!ACTIVE', 'SETTLED')
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_overdue.has_overdue_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND COUNT(*) > SUM(CASE WHEN has_overdue.has_overdue_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC,
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower_party.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee_party.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower_party ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower_party.party_id
JOIN party payee_party ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee_party.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT

ORDER BY

SELECT

ORDER BY

SELECT

    ld.loan_id ASC

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,

SELECT

    ld.disbursement_account_id,

    ld.disbursed_amount

ORDER BY
