SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000.0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
      AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
),
loan_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT party_id FROM related_borrowers)
),
avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM loan_rates
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family
)
SELECT 
    lr.borrower_name,
    lr.borrower_party_id,
    lr.annual_interest_rate,
    ar.avg_rate AS avg_institution_rate,
    ROUND(lr.annual_interest_rate - ar.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM loan_rates lr
JOIN avg_rates ar 
    ON lr.institution_id = ar.institution_id 
   AND lr.product_family = ar.product_family
WHERE lr.annual_interest_rate < ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_src ON ld_src.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_tgt ON ld_tgt.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
)
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rtc.relation_name_zh
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30' AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY'
WHERE eg.effective_to IS NULL
  AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer_party.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee_party.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder from_ah ON from_acc.account_id = from_ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party payer_party ON from_ah.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder to_ah ON to_acc.account_id = to_ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party payee_party ON to_ah.party_id = payee_party.party_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON payer_party.party_id = pr.source_party_id 
                      AND payee_party.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
    AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    payer_party.party_id, 
    payer_party.display_name, 
    payee_party.party_id, 
    payee_party.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
    AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    product_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot
WHERE 
    investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY 
    product_id
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON l.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > 90000000.0
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    l.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING 
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 
    max_overdue_days DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND (egm.effective_to IS NULL OR egm.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party![]()party_id
),
guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
qualified_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        bt.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        bt.total_loan_amount,
        gt.total_guarantee_amount,
        (gt.total_guarantee_amount - bt.total_loan_amount) AS guarantee_diff
    FROM borrower_totals bt
    JOIN guarantor_totals gt ON bt.borrower_party_id = gt.party_id
    WHERE gt.total_guarantee_amount > bt.total_loan_amount
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    ROUND(qp.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS total_guarantee_amount,
    ROUND(qp.total_loan_amount, 2) AS total_loan_amount,
    ROUND(qp.guarantee_diff, 2) AS guarantee_diff
FROM qualified_parties qp
JOIN party p ON qp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY qp.guarantee_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS multiple
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    ROUND(ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2.0
ORDER BY 
    multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account acc ON ld.disbursement_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE 
    ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND acc.is_external = 0
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_due_amount,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN pp.annual_income IS NULL OR pp.annual_income = 0 THEN 0.00
            ELSE SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income
        END, 
        2
    ) AS income_multiple
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 
    income_multiple DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY 
    lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_over_90_days_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM 
    account_holder ah
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND rs.principal_due > 0
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
HAVING 
    SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND rs.principal_due > 90000000.0
ORDER BY 
    rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital), 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON cf.facility_id = (SELECT facility_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
ORDER BY 
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
WHERE 
    cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY 
    cf.facility_type
ORDER BY 
    record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' AND actual_raise_amount IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN minimum_holding_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS min_holding_positive_count
    FROM ranked_products
    GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    min_holding_positive_count AS product_count
FROM group_stats
WHERE min_holding_positive_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
    AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY 
    total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    pending_instruction_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
    s.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM 
    instrument_type_catalog i
CROSS JOIN 
    status_catalog s
WHERE 
    s.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY 
    i.name_zh, 
    s.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
  AND ds.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM delinquency_snapshot 
      WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM risk_classification 
      WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < (ps.required_amount * 0.5)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS total_provision_gap
FROM 
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ROUND(ABS(bs.ledger_balance), 2) AS ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
  AND bs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM account_balance_snapshot 
      WHERE account_id = a.account_id
  )
ORDER BY bs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    ma.asset_category_primary AS asset_category,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
    AND ma.asset_scope = 'NON_STANDARDIZED'
GROUP BY 
    ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC, 
    asset_category ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    debt_service_ratio > 3.0
ORDER BY 
    debt_service_ratio DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    person_profile pp
JOIN 
    party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM 
    payment_card pc
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY 
    pc.status
ORDER BY 
    card_count DESC,
    card_status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC,
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND ptc.name_zh IN ('现金存入', '现金支取')
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
GROUP BY 
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC,
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id OR pe.to_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND ct.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY 
    ct.name_zh
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_amount DESC,
    ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS average_amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY 
    channel
HAVING 
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) > 11780000.00
ORDER BY 
    average_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT 
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    reference_count DESC, 
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    so.agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,!
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) ld ON so.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, so.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    coverage_gap > 0
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 0
    AND (lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount) >= 4.0
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, 
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_over_provision_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC, 
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.collateral_id,
        ca.asset_label,
        MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_internal_value
    FROM collateral_asset ca
    JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY ca.coll!ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.collateral_id,
        ca.asset_label,
        MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_external_value
    FROM collateral_asset ca
    JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    WHERE cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
)
SELECT 
    im.collateral_id AS "抵押物编号",
    im.asset_label AS "抵押物名称",
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value, 2) AS "内部评估最高价值",
    ROUND(em.max_external_value, 2) AS "外部评估最高价值",
    ROUND((im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value), 2) AS "低估差额"
FROM internal_max im
JOIN external_max em ON im.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE em.max_external_value < im.max_internal_value
ORDER BY (im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cv.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_borrowed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount),!2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
    AND p.party_id = borrower.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    etc.name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_type_catalog etc ON eg.group_type = etc.group_type
WHERE 
    eg.effective_to IS NULL
    AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    etc.name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 
    member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON (p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
    AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS source_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_src ON pr.source_party_id = ca_src.borrower_party_id AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = ca_tgt.borrower_party_id AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY 
    pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY 
    (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id 
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS "保证人编号",
    p.display_name AS "保证人名称",
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS "有效保证责任合计",
    ROUND(COALESCE(borrower_stats.total_principal, 0), 2)!_principal, 0), 2) AS "超额担保金额"
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM 
        credit_agreement ca
    JOIN 
        loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN 
        loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE 
        lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY 
        ca.borrower_party_id
) borrower_stats ON p.party_id = borrower_stats.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, borrower_stats.total_principal
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(borrower_stats.total_principal, 0)
ORDER BY 
    "超额担保金额" DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS guarantee_status
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, gc.guaranteed_amount, gc.status
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(d.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
    AND wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
    AND d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY 
    total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_coll.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca_coll ON cl.collateral_id = ca_coll.collateral_id AND ca_coll.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (cl.collateral_id IS NOT NULL OR gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_coll.collateral_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    phs.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY 
    phs.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING 
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_inversion_amount DESC, phs.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    party issuer_party ON ma.issuer_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON issuer_party.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND wp.issuer_institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ca.agreement_id LIMIT 1) -- Redundant if single bank, but ensures logical consistency
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cl.lien_priority = 1 AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS first_priority_active_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cl.lien_priority = 1 AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cl.lien_priority = 1 AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM 
    financial_snapshot fs
JOIN 
    institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            party_id, 
            as_of_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY party_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) as rn
        FROM 
            financial_snapshot
    ) latest ON fs.party_id = latest.party_id AND fs.as_of_date = latest.as_of_date AND latest.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = SUBSTR(fs.party_id, 5)
WHERE 
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    core_tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id)
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

WITH institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM financial_snapshot 
        WHERE party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    )
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS sum_revenue
    FROM institution_revenue
)
SELECT 
    ir.institution_name,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution_revenue ir
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
WHERE (ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    so.status = 'ACTIVE' 
    AND sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC, 
    so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

WITH under_provisioned_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS total_under_provisioned
    FROM
        provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN
        loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN
        credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE
        ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY
        ca.institution_id
),
institution_net_assets AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.net_assets
    FROM
        institution i
    JOIN
        financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id)
    WHERE
        fs.as_of_date = '202!6-06-30'
        AND fs.source_kind = 'REGULATORY'
)
SELECT
    upl.institution_id AS "机构编号",
    ina.institution_name AS "机构名称",
    ROUND(upl.total_under_provisioned, 2) AS "少计提总额",
    ROUND(ina.net_assets, 2) AS "净资产",
    ROUND((upl.total_under_provisioned * 1.0 / ina.net_assets) * 100, 2) AS "少计提占净资产百分比"
FROM
    under_provisioned_loans upl
JOIN
    institution_net_assets ina ON upl.institution_id = ina.institution_id
WHERE
    upl.total_under_provisioned > 0
ORDER BY
    (upl.total_under_provisioned * 1.0 / ina.net_assets) DESC,
    upl.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY 
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, 
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND ds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = fs.party_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(fs.annual_revenue, 0), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(MAX(cs.risk_weighted_assets), 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / MAX(cs.risk_weighted_assets)) * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM 
    institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id 
        AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    MAX(cs.risk_weighted_assets) > 0
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pms.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pms.amount_value), 2) AS total_abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pms.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100.0, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM 
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pms
JOIN 
    institution i ON pms.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON pms.institution_id = cs.institution_id 
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = pms.institution_id)
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || pms.institution_id) 
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = ('PTY-' || pms.institution_id))
WHERE 
    pms.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(pms.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS regulatory_overdue_records,
    ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_record_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id 
    AND rse.event_code = 'OVERDUE_REPORTING' 
    AND rse.deadline_date < '2026-06-30' 
    AND rse.completion_date IS NULL
WHERE 
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.ratio_value END), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS distinct_target_parties,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS distinct_relation_types,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.re!relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_count
FROM 
    related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN 
    party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    distinct_target_parties DESC,
    distinct_relation_types DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_abnormal_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM account a 
        WHERE a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id 
        AND a.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
LEFT JOIN 
    operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id 
    AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 
    operational_risk_abnormal_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pe.record_id) AS behavior_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pe ON i.institution_id = pe.institution_id AND wp.product_id = pe.subject_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND pe.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(pe.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cre.record_id) AS valid_custody_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cre.exception_flag = 1 THEN cre.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END),!0.00) AS exception_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
JOIN 
    custody_operation_event_v3 cre ON i.institution_id = cre.institution_id 
    AND cre.subject_id = ma.asset_id
    AND cre.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cre.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
